payload.title: Judge rubric: figurative substitution and riddle phrasing
payload.description:
As a copy editor, I want the judge prompt to name figurative substitution and riddle phrasing as finding kinds with examples, so the model lane catches the forms no regex can.

Feature: Judge voice prompt
  Scenario: Judge system prompt names figurative substitution and riddle phrasing
    When I read the judge system prompt
    Then the judge system prompt names the figurative_substitution kind
    And the judge system prompt names the riddle_phrasing kind
